description: Two remortgage deals over the length of the fix, fees included: the monthly payments, the total, and the tracker rate at which both cost the same. Use for 'should I fix at 4.3% or take a tracker at 4.6%' - the figures, not a recommendation.

fixedFee.description: The fixed deal's fee. Defaults to 0.

fixedYears.description: Length of the fix in years. Defaults to 5.

trackerDriftPctPerYear.description: Assumed change in the tracker rate each year, in percentage points. Defaults to 0.

trackerFee.description: The tracker deal's fee. Defaults to 0.

name: calculate_remortgage
title: Remortgage: fixed or tracker
